items.title: Darden Restaurants (DRI) Stock Looks About Fairly Priced Despite Its 76% Run
items.summary: Darden Restaurants stock has delivered a solid multi year gain, and at around US$220 per share the current valuation now looks close to its estimated intrinsic value on a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) basis and roughly in line with market multiples rather than clearly cheap or clearly expensive. Darden Restaurants has returned 76.1% over 5 years, which puts extra focus on whether the current price still leaves enough room for long term upside.
